https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract

Monograph PDF includes a Windows build of Tesseract under engines/ocr and
ships language data (eng, jpn, osd) under models/tessdata for fully offline
optical character recognition. Trained data files originate from the
tessdata_fast / tessdata repositories and retain their upstream licensing.
